description: Baseline KPI compliance policies and condition specifications for automated call audits.

kpis.description: RM must maintain professional, courteous language and must not use aggressive, disrespectful, or unprofessional speech.
kpis.false_positive_risk: High if customer anger or vulgarity is misattributed to RM.

exclusions: customer expressing frustration while RM remains professional

kpis.description: RM must not provide direct, unauthorized buy/sell trading advice or stock tips outside official research recommendations.
kpis.false_positive_risk: Customer asking for tips or discussing stocks must not be flagged as RM misconduct unless RM explicitly provides unauthorized guidance.

exclusions: citing official HDFC Securities research reports with standard disclaimers

kpis.description: RM must never promise or imply guaranteed profits, returns, or capital protection on market-linked securities.
kpis.false_positive_risk: Customer demanding guarantees or asking 'is this return guaranteed?' must not be attributed as RM violation.

exclusions: explaining fixed income products with statutory deposit insurance

kpis.description: RM must communicate mandatory statutory risk warnings when discussing derivatives, equity investments, or leveraged products.
kpis.false_positive_risk: Medium if disclaimer was delivered in customer-selected regional language or shortened standard closing.

kpis.description: RM must identify themselves by name and branch, and perform mandatory client authentication before discussing account specifics.
kpis.false_positive_risk: Low to medium if authentication was conducted via SMS OTP or IVR prior to call transfer.

kpis.description: RM must clearly articulate margin requirements, squared-off conditions, and interest levies on funded positions.
kpis.false_positive_risk: High if client confusion regarding margin calls is misread as RM non-disclosure.

violation_triggers: failure to disclose margin shortfall liquidation timeline

kpis.description: RM must never solicit, store, or share client passwords, PINs, OTPs, or CVVs.
kpis.false_positive_risk: High if client offers OTP unprompted and RM actively stops the customer from revealing it.

exclusions: RM warning customer never to share OTP/password

kpis.description: RM must only suggest investment products matching the customer's stated risk profile and investment horizon.
kpis.false_positive_risk: Medium if client unsolicitedly requests speculative options trading.

violation_triggers: pitching high risk F&O to conservative risk profile client

kpis.description: RM must acknowledge customer dissatisfaction, log a grievance reference, and explain escalation channels.
kpis.false_positive_risk: Customer complaints should trigger grievance SLA, not disciplinary misconduct against RM if handled correctly.

kpis.description: RM must summarize discussion points, recite order parameters accurately, and conclude with standard closing protocol.
kpis.false_positive_risk: Low if call gets disconnected abruptly by customer.
